intent: Stack a control's caption, description and message in one column beside the control.
typical_uses: The label and description column beside a Switch or a Checkbox in a horizontal Field

dont_use_when.situation: A vertical Field where the caption, the control and the description already stack

instead.note: Put FieldLabel, the control and FieldDescription directly inside the Field.

invariants.text: FieldContent stacks its children in a column with a --space-1 gap and grows to take the row's free space.

anti_patterns.dont: Put the control itself inside FieldContent
anti_patterns.do_instead: Keep the control a direct child of the Field, beside the FieldContent

good.title: A checkbox with its label and description beside it
good.code:
<Field orientation="horizontal">
  <Checkbox id="terms" />
  <FieldContent>
    <FieldLabel htmlFor="terms">Accept the terms</FieldLabel>
    <FieldDescription>You can withdraw at any time.</FieldDescription>
  </FieldContent>
</Field>

bad.title: The control wrapped into the content column
bad.why: The column stacks the checkbox under its caption instead of beside it; the control belongs directly in the Field.
